name: linaclotide
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Diarrhea: Patients may experience severe diarrhea. If severe diarrhea occurs, suspend dosing and rehydrate the patient. ( 5.2 ) 5.1 Risk of Serious Dehydration in Pediatric Patients Less Than 2 Years of Age LINZESS is contraindicated in patients less than 2 years of age. I
contraindications: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS LINZESS is contraindicated in: Patients less than 2 years of age due to the risk of serious dehydration [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 ), Use in Specific Populations ( 8.4 )]
